name: Heroic Ethos

attributes.attribute: pan-Celtic warrior code of honour and fame
achieved personal fame in a struggle against odds
hero of the tribe, champion and defender
hero outside the tribe, wanderer and outlaw
honour shown through the best share at the feast

text: The heroic ethos runs through the early Celtic literatures. It binds bravery, honour, and gift-giving. A hero wins fame in a struggle against stiff odds. He feeds the tribe and defends its life. Feasting shows rank through the distribution of portions. The finest share, the champion's portion, marks the senior warrior. Slights demand revenge. This code shapes both Irish and Welsh war tradition. The hero must die well to keep his name alive.

okr.objective: Define the shared code of the Celtic hero across Irish and Welsh tradition.
key_results: Show fame and honour as the marker of the hero
Show gift-giving and the champion's portion at feast
Name Cú Chulainn and Finn mac Cumhaill as model heroes
